exposure: Spot urine protein to creatinine ratio (uPCR)
cohort: Four hundred Thai pregnant women diagnosed with preeclampsia who delivered at Thammasat University Hospital in Thailand between January 2014 and August 2018
finding: A spot urine protein to creatinine ratio (uPCR) of 1.0 or greater was found to be a useful predictor of adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes in women with preeclampsia.
